translations.web: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.
translations.bsb: especially since you are acquainted with all the Jewish customs and controversies. I beg you, therefore, to listen to me patiently.
translations.kjv: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.
translations.asv: especially because thou art expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.
